This circular did not require implementation.

Sequence.DefectDescription: The line of business was not up to date per standards and required an update to the structure. Database tables had multiple parents associated, Varying deductible was not at the form level, Properties of pages, page fields and premium calculations were not aligned per the manual. Experience Rating, Schedule rating and IRPM data capture were at page level instead of at applicable risk level. Please see the solution for further details.

Solutions.GeneralSolution: Structure of the line of business has been updated to include following changes. Database tables have been updated to remove multiple parents and indicate associated risk level. Pages have been updated to indicate if they are static or have variable data. Page fields have been updated to indicate if they are print required. Varying deductible has been moved to the form level and no longer have individual database tables associated with them. Rating worksheet has been updated to include all varying deductible tables as well as display all associated calculations. Properties of the pages, page fields and form premium calculations have been aligned as per the manual. Experience Rating, schedule Rating and IRPM data capture and calculations have been moved to the applicable risk levels.
